content.text: Perfect! I've successfully standardized your Metropolitan Museum TSV file. Here's what I did: ## Key Standardization Changes: **1. Added Header Row** - The original file was missing column headers, so I added: `Object Date | Title | Object Number | Link Resource` **2. Handled Missing Data** - Replaced empty title fields with `[Unknown]` for consistency - Added `[Unknown Date]` where dates were missing entirely **3. Cleaned Formatting** - Removed excessive quotation marks around titles - Removed HTML encoding (like `` and `` tags) - Cleaned up overly long descriptions by truncating extremely verbose catalog entries - Standardized special characters throughout **4. Normalized Text** - Removed extra spaces and irregular line breaks in titles - Standardized quotation usage (converted curly quotes to straight quotes) - Made title capitalization more consistent **5. Preserved Data Integrity** - Kept all object numbers intact (even complex ones with multiple parts) - Maintained all URLs without modification - Preserved date information exactly as provided The standardized file is ready to download and should work much better with spreadsheet applications or data processing tools!
